scenarios.name: Wi-Fi Drop & Reconnect
scenarios.fault: Abrupt socket disconnect after seq=5; reconnect with resume_from_seq=6
scenarios.expected: Session continuity (same session_id), last_seq_acked=5, 10 samples total
scenarios.observed: Same session: True, last_seq_acked=5, stored=10 samples

scenarios.name: Server Restart Mid-Session
scenarios.fault: Server process reboots mid-stream; client resumes with resume_from_seq=6
scenarios.expected: Server starts cleanly, accepts resume sequence, acknowledges seq 10

scenarios.name: Dashboard Subscriber Restart
scenarios.fault: Viewer disconnects while ingest streams; re-queries REST on reconnect
scenarios.expected: Ingest pipeline unaffected; 0 samples dropped; full backlog accessible
scenarios.observed: First received seq=1, final ingest ack=5, resynced samples=5

scenarios.name: Phone Sleep & Wake Transition
scenarios.fault: 15s telemetry gap while phone screen sleeps; sample sent upon wake
scenarios.expected: Connection transitions LIVE -> STALE (>10s) -> LIVE upon next sample

scenarios.name: Duplicate Seq Retransmission
scenarios.fault: Client re-sends seq=3 after receiving cumulative ack 5
scenarios.expected: Idempotent immediate ack for seq=3; duplicate recorded; 5 unique rows stored
scenarios.observed: Ack returned=True, duplicate metric=1, stored rows=5

scenarios.name: Slow Subscriber Backpressure
scenarios.fault: 6 broadcast frames pushed to slow subscriber with queue capacity 3
scenarios.expected: Bounded queue cap enforced (<=3); oldest dropped; DroppedEvent emitted
scenarios.loss_explanation: Oldest frames dropped for slow subscriber only; ingest unaffected
